title: Farmer Brown: Win a Private Dining Experience for Six
prize: Three winners each receive a private-chef dinner for themselves and five guests, all aged 18+. Venue/date are agreed after the draw; the promoter may substitute a dinner-at-home kit where a dinner cannot be hosted locally.
entrySummary: Entrants must be in South Africa, aged 18+, with a South African ID, passport or documentary proof of South African residency under the written rules. Promoter-linked people and their immediate family are excluded. The live entry form specifically asks for a South African ID number. Buy two products from the participating Nourish/Naked list at SPAR, Checkers or Pick n Pay. Use the campaign QR code or the official campaign site linked below. Provide the required name/contact/location details, choose the retailer, accept the competition terms, and upload a full, clear receipt. Marketing opt-in is presented separately. Keep your original till slip. Multiple entries need separate qualifying purchases; a participant may win once. Winner plus five guests must all be 18+. Travel, accommodation, extra food/drink and tips are excluded. Dinner must take place within three months of notification; confirm availability within the promoter’s ten-working-day window. Beverage pairing may include alcohol. Dinner photography/publicity provisions apply. Terms broadly permit marketing processing, despite the form offering a yes/no opt-in choice. Winner verification includes identification/residency evidence and the original receipt. Participating products/prize allocation from the official terms: Farmer Brown Frozen Fillet Sourdough — 360g — 6001407106849 — F/BROWN FILLET FRZ 360G S/DOUG; Farmer Brown Frozen Fillet Wholegrain — 360g — 6001407106856 — F/BROWN FILLET FRZ 360G W/GRN; Farmer Brown Frozen Fillet Lightly Dusted — 360g — 6001407106863 — F/BROWN FILLET FRZ 360G L/BRD; Farmer Brown Frozen Strips Sourdough — 400g — 6001407107839 — F/BROWN STRIPS 400GR SOURDOUGH; Farmer Brown Frozen Strips Wholegrain — 400g — 6001407107846 — F/BROWN STRIPS 400GR WHLEGRAIN; Farmer Brown Frozen Strips Lightly Dusted — 400g — 6001407107853 — F/BROWN STRIPS 400GR LIBREADED; Farmer Brown Naked Frozen Breast — 1kg — 6001407108119 — F/BROWN NAKED FRZ 1KG BRST FIL; Farmer Brown Naked Frozen Thighs — 1kg — 6001407108089 — F/BROWN NAKED FRZ 1KG THIGHS; Farmer Brown Naked Frozen Drumsticks — 1kg — 6001407108102 — F/BROWN NAKED FRZ IKG DRUMS.
costSummary: Purchase required; internet/data and travel to the dinner are at the entrant’s or guests’ cost.
reviewGap: The written rules allow passport/residency evidence, but the form asks for a South African ID. Do not promise that every eligible non-ID holder can complete the form; promoter clarification is still needed. Terms and form differ on marketing consent. Keep the conflict visible in editorial review.

title: Pizza Hut Rugby Campaign: Win Springbok Merchandise
prize: Springbok shirts, pre-match tops, bucket hats, caps, beanies and tumblers. Prizes are bundled at the promoter’s discretion; this is not a ticket or travel prize.
entrySummary: Permanent residents of South Africa aged 18+, holding valid identification. Promoter-linked employees, suppliers, agencies and specified family/business connections are excluded. Buy the qualifying Kickoff Combo, online or in store, at a South African Pizza Hut outlet. Scan the campaign QR code on the box. Follow the WhatsApp landing-page prompts and send a clear receipt photo. Keep a copy of the receipt. Complete your entry by the stated closing date. Use a separate qualifying purchase and receipt for a further entry. Draw scheduled for 10 November 2026; agency contacts winners by SMS. Respond within 48 hours as required by the rules; contact failures can result in replacement winners. Jersey sizes are assigned by the promoter. No size exchanges, refunds, cash alternative or transfer. Only the Pizza Hut-allocated merchandise prizes qualify; broader Coca-Cola campaign prizes do not automatically apply. Participating products/prize allocation from the official terms: SARU MEN’S 2025 NIKE HOME JERSEY — 10; NIKE SPRINGBOKS PRE MATCH TOP — 10; REVERSIBLE WORLD CHAMPIONS BUCKET HAT — 10; SPRINGBOK COKE CAP — 10; SPRINGBOKS QUARTZ BEANIE — 20; SPRINGBOKS TUMBLER WITH HANDLE AND STRAW — 10.
costSummary: Qualifying Kickoff Combo purchase required. Mobile/data charges may apply.
reviewGap: The rules state both one entry per receipt and an example of four entries for four deals on one receipt. An entry multiplier is unconfirmed; ask the promoter before relying on it. The pack QR destination has not been independently verified; no direct WhatsApp number is supplied.

title: Radio 2000 and 1Life: Win Cash on Air
prize: R50,000 total cash pool. On-air boxes start at R2,000; the top box is R8,000, with a possible R2,000 quote bonus for up to R10,000.
entrySummary: South African citizens over 18. Promoter-linked people and specified family/business connections are excluded. Anyone who won a 1Life-promoted competition in the previous 12 months cannot enter. Use the station-linked official website, or SMS 1Life Cover to 45690 at R1.50. Give accurate contact details and be available for the station’s selection and on-air call. The website presents a quote-consent checkbox. If selected, choose one of the five boxes labelled 1, L, I, F and E. The written rules allow one entry per person per week. A qualifying obligation-free life-cover quote gives a R2,000 bonus; an insurance purchase is not required. Entry terms include marketing consent and consent to an ITC check. Winner must provide citizenship and banking proof. Cash payment is stated as within 30 business days after documents and ITC checks are completed. The R10,000 headline is a maximum including the quote bonus, not a guaranteed prize.
costSummary: SMS 1Life Cover to 45690 costs R1.50; free SMS bundles do not apply. Website entry uses data. Reply-YES entry is only described for people who receive the promoter’s direct SMS and is reverse-billed.
reviewGap: Written terms describe a quote as optional for bonus winnings, but the website presents quote consent within its entry form. Confirm required consent before using the website. Station and insurer pages give different opening dates; insurer rules state 29 October. No entry was submitted.

brand: TimesLIVE / Sowetan · sponsored by Toyota South Africa
title: Share Your Toyota Corolla Story for a Chance to Win a Merchandise Hamper
prize: Toyota merchandise hamper and a story feature. The publisher does not specify the contents or value. No vehicle is advertised as a prize.
entrySummary: The campaign asks for authentic South African voices and a Corolla ownership story or memory. Minimum age, citizenship/residency rules, employee exclusions and proof-of-ownership requirements are not specified. Do not assume current ownership is compulsory or that eligibility is unrestricted. Write your own Corolla ownership story or memory in no more than 500 words. The publisher asks for original stories and authentic voices; it says there is no need to use AI. Attach a photograph of yourself. Including the Corolla from your story is encouraged, rather than stated as compulsory. Include your full name and region. Use the exact email subject shown below. Email the story and photo to the publisher by Friday 13 November 2026. Check the official page for any updates before submitting. Email: motoringsales@arena.africa. Exact subject: 60 Years of Toyota Corolla. The winner must collect the prize in Johannesburg, Gauteng. Collection timing, transport reimbursement and courier alternatives are not specified. The winner acknowledges sharing of personal details with relevant parties and publication of the story and images on Arena platforms. The terms grant the organiser a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence of indefinite duration and worldwide scope to use the winner’s name, image and likeness for promotion. Photos and stories may be edited, published or shared across media without fresh approval or further payment; the terms also include a release of related claims. Read the complete publisher terms before deciding to enter. FreeHub does not receive entries or select the winner.
costSummary: The instructions describe email entry and do not request a purchase, subscription or entry fee. An explicit no-purchase/free-entry rule is not provided. Normal email/data costs and travel to collect the prize may apply.
reviewGap: Minimum age, citizenship/residency eligibility and employee/family exclusions. Precise closing time/time zone and campaign opening date. Entry limit, selection/judging method, draw date, notification route and response deadline. Exact hamper contents/value and detailed prize-collection arrangements. An explicit no-purchase/free-entry rule and any additional campaign terms beyond the article. The available article instructions were checked; inbox delivery was not tested.
